question: Standard level 1 White Lion victory: who gains weapon proficiency, what are the rewards, and when do we add Catarium?

record.title: White Lion level 1 aftermath and rewards
record.keywords: standard white lion level one level 1 aftermath victory victorious defeated defeat rewards resources hunt xp weapon proficiency level catarium jewelry loss return
record.layout: The story-event Aftermath column gives level 1 victory and defeat. The right reward panel gives the level-specific resource counts and first-victory Catarium addition. Printed page 43 supplies proficiency eligibility.
record.summary: On a standard level 1 White Lion victory, survivors gain +1 Hunt XP and eligible survivors gain +1 weapon proficiency level. The group gains 4 basic resources and 4 White Lion resources. The first time the group defeats a White Lion, add Catarium to the settlement locations. Apply proficiency eligibility rather than granting it to every survivor.
notes: To gain the proficiency level, a survivor must have selected a weapon type and wounded a monster at least once with that type during the showdown, then be victorious. Without a selected type the survivor cannot gain proficiency unless a rule states otherwise.

The White Lion defeat instruction applies when the survivors lose: roll 1d10; on 6+, archive one jewelry gear of your choice. If survivors have no jewelry, nothing happens. Consult other applicable death/return rules separately.
The First Story has its own victory instructions and dead-survivor gear exception. Do not apply that exception to every later showdown.
These records cover the level 1 aftermath; level 2/3 rewards and Saga effects remain outside this unit.

sources.title: White Lion Basic Action and Monster Reference card

response.answer:
On a **standard level 1 White Lion victory**:

- **Hunt XP:** Each survivor gains +1 Hunt XP.
- **Weapon proficiency:** An eligible survivor gains +1 weapon proficiency level only if they had selected a weapon type, wounded the monster at least once with that type during the showdown, and were victorious. It is not granted to every survivor automatically.
- **Resources:** The group gains 4 basic resources and 4 White Lion resources.
- **Catarium:** Add Catarium to the settlement locations the first time the group defeats a White Lion.
